# `conv`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
conv(num, from_base, to_base)
```

Convert `num` from `from_base` to `to_base`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |

| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- conv, example 1
> SELECT conv('100', 2, 10);

```

```sql

> SELECT conv(-10, 16, -10);
```
